messages.subject: GGplot Map Error
parts:
I am trying to plot the annual ridership using ggplot2. My Data doesnt have longitude and latitude variables. But I extreacted it using geocode.
After plotting the points , my map shrinks (attachement ). Pls Suggest.

My code is as follows;


library(ggplot2)
library(maps)
library(ggmap)
# load us map data
USmap<-map_data("state")
p <- ggplot()  
p <- p + geom_polygon(data=USmap, aes(x=long, y=lat, group = group),colour="white", fill="grey10" )
p
lng<-ll$lon
latt<-ll$lat
p<-p+geom_point(data=transit,aes(x=lng,y=latt,size=sqrt(transit$Annual.Rship)),colour="#b5e521",shrink=FALSE)+scale_size(name="Annual Ridership")
p

messages.author: deb3c9be98a98104
messages.subject: Overlay trend line on log-log
parts:
I suspect I'm overlooking the obvious, but I can’t manage to overlay a straight on the log scale plot to show that the trend in linear in the logarithms

Noise <- rlnorm(50)*0.01
A <- seq(1,50,by=1)
B <- 0.5*A^1.5*Noise
Data <- as.data.frame(cbind(A,B))

ggplot(Data,aes(A, B)) + geom_point() + coord_trans(x="log10", y="log10”)  

The scatter plot is obviously linear on double log scale, but how to show it with a trend line? Adding geom_smooth doesn’t work


ggplot(Data,aes(A, B), na.rm=TRUE) + geom_point() + coord_trans(x="log10", y="log10") + stat_smooth(method=lm, formula = log10(y) ~ log10(x), na.rm=TRUE)
Error in if (zero_range(range)) { : missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed
In addition: Warning message:
In trans$transform(out$range) : NaNs produced

Should I call the coefficients from a regression and use geom_abline?

Thanks,
Mark

messages.author: f4249b01b99d0091
messages.subject: Re: Overlay trend line on log-log
parts:
You probably want to transform the scale, not the coordinate system?
E.g. this works:

ggplot(Data,aes(A,B))+geom_point() +scale_x_log10() +
scale_y_log10()+geom_smooth(method='lm')

The difference between these is explained (briefly) at
http://docs.ggplot2.org/current/coord_trans.html

HTH,
Ben
